"Xiaomi Offline Communication is a Bluetooth-based voice call service (hereinafter referred to as \"this Service\") provided by Xiaomi Inc. (hereinafter referred to as \"Xiaomi\", \"we\", \"our\", or \"us\"). We take the protection of your privacy and personal information seriously. We'll provide corresponding security protection measures for your personal information in accordance with legal requirements and industry standards.
When you turn this feature on, we'll access your contacts, phone number, Xiaomi Account sign-in status, Bluetooth MAC address, call status, and SIM card status to allow you to communicate with selected contacts when not connected to the internet.
When you turn on \"Display location\" and \"Turn on automatically in an earthquake\", we'll collect your precise location for display to your selected contacts.
This information will only be processed on your device and won't be uploaded to the cloud.
The following permissions are required when you use Xiaomi Offline Communication:
• Bluetooth permissions: for making calls to nearby devices
• Access contacts: for discovering and calling nearby contacts
• Permission to connect to the internet: for connecting to the network and accessing map content
• Access location: for displaying precise location to selected contacts
• Phone permissions: for accessing call status (Xiaomi Offline Communication can't be used when a call is in progress)
If you don't agree to the above permissions, you won't be able to use this service.
Some features are provided by third-party service providers. For this reason, we need to provide some of your personal information to these third parties. Tap here to view the circumstances under which we share your personal information with our affiliates, partners, and third parties.
We will only process your personal information for the period of collection as described in this privacy statement or as required by applicable laws.
This service (Xiaomi Offline Communication) and its related operations are managed by Xiaomi. We've set up a dedicated department for personal information protection. If you have any questions or comments about this privacy statement, or about our collection, use, or disclosure of your personal information, you can contact us on https://privacy.mi.com/support. We'll generally respond within fifteen business days.
Tap \"Agree\" to indicate that you've read and agreed to this privacy statement."
